summary.text: Diane Pauer is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 36 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; she assumed her current seat in December 2022.
An engineer, she lives in Brookline, New Hampshire.

paragraphs.text: Diane Pauer lives in Brookline, New Hampshire.
She earned a B.S. in electrical engineering from Worcester Polytechnic Institute, and her career experience includes working as a digital and firmware design engineer and as a technical instructor.
Ballotpedia lists Pauer's tenure in the New Hampshire House as beginning in 2020, and she assumed her current seat representing Hillsborough 36 on December 7, 2022.
She was assigned to the Municipal and County Government Committee in 2021-2022 and served as its vice chair in 2023-2024.
